$comment: Pins the session's recommendation on `identity_hint.type` (#176 item 18), which is NOT an owner ruling: the owner ruled on `accepted_identity_types` only. If the owner rejects the recommendation, this fixture and its commit are dropped. The body is man-005's without `extensions`, with `identity_hint.type` set to `x509`, a Reserved row of registries/identity-types.md that no `aitp/0.3` implementation implements. The hint carries only `type` and `subject`, so no member rule of a registered type applies. Before RC2.1 every verifier returned MANIFEST_INVALID for this Manifest.
description: Manifest whose `identity_hint.type` is a type the verifier does not implement (`x509`). RFC-AITP-0003 §3.1 (recommended text): the hint type is open, the member rules for `oidc`, `pinned_key` and `spiffe` apply only to those types, and Manifest verification does not interpret the hint. Version, expiry, PoP and signature pass, so the Manifest verifies. A handshake from this agent would present `x509` in `payload.identity` and fail at RFC-AITP-0004 §5.1 step 6 with IDENTITY_FAILED for a verifier that does not implement it (RFC-AITP-0002 §5).

expected.rationale: Schema-valid under the open hint type, and cryptographically valid, so `verify_manifest` succeeds. The hint is static metadata and Manifest verification does not verify an identity proof (RFC-AITP-0003 §5). An unimplemented identity type is rejected where it is used, in the handshake descriptor, with IDENTITY_FAILED (RFC-AITP-0002 §5; RFC-AITP-0004 §5.1 step 6).
